 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Ebrima Tunkara is one of the hottest talents in a Barcelona academy that has produced players such as Pau Cubarsi and Lamine Yamal in recent years.
 An attacking midfielder by trade, the 16-year-old has turned heads with his performances at the youth level and is already attracting expensive valuations.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement One of the most valued U17 players
 Popular football valuation website Transfermarkt has recently issued a market value update for some of the young players in world football, in which Tunkara has emerged as one of the biggest beneficiaries.
 At the age of just 16, Tunkara has already attracted a valuation of €5 million, thus making him one of the most valuable U-17 players in world football.
 This comes on the back of his success at La Masia , with the young playmaker already becoming a key player for Barça Atletic under Juliano Belletti.
 Tunkara looks to be on his way to following the footsteps of previous La Masia talents such as Lamine Yamal and Ansu Fati.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Transfermarkt has unveiled Yamal as one of the most expensive U20 players in the history, followed by Max Dowman of Arsenal. Ansu Fati features on the list in third position, with a valuation of €25 million.
 If Tunkara continues his progress at Barcelona, he is expected to beat Fati's €25 million milestone in a few years.
 Tunkara's road to the first-team
 Tunkara's valuation jump from here on in, though, will largely depend on whether or not he can make a breakthrough in the first-team.
 Flick is closely monitoring Tunkara. (Photo by Julian Finney/Getty Images)
 In fact, among the top five most valued U17 players right now, Tunkara is the only one yet to make his first-team debut.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The ones ahead of him, such as Dowman, Believe Munongo, Jorge Dominguez and Niko Ilicevic have all made debuts for their respective first-teams.
 Fortunately for Tunkara, he appears to be rated highly at Barcelona and coach Hansi Flick is well aware of his rapid progression.
 Flick has never been shy in giving youngsters the opportunity to shine. Barcelona have also ruled out the possibility of Tunkara's exit , especially amid interest from Aston Villa, among other clubs.
